$comment: DDSP-SVC 6.3 singing voices (vc::families::ddsp_svc, P5-A; ADR 0006). Both entries are Sigil exports and stay unpublished (asset hosting is local only): install them with the Models tab's Import or SIGIL_LOCAL_ASSETS (scripts/vc-families/ddsp_svc/export_templates.py --vocoder stages them in %LOCALAPPDATA%/sigil-dev-cache/vc-assets).

vc/ddsp-svc-6.3: the template graphs without weights (export_templates.py; yxlllc/DDSP-SVC 6.3 @d6dd52fc architecture, MIT). A voice's weights come from its own checkpoint at import; layout.json is also embedded in the engine (src-tauri/src/services/neural_audio/vc/families/ddsp_svc/layout.json): an installed template must carry the same weights_id and graphs (sha256 and size), or voices refuse to load with a reinstall message.

vc/vocoder-pc-nsf-hifigan-44k: openvpi pc_nsf_hifigan_44.1k_hop512_128bin_2025.02 exported by scripts/vc-families/ddsp_svc/export.py (weights folded, Sigil's phase0 input) plus the release's config.json.

entries.title: DDSP-SVC 6.3 graphs
entries.description: Sigil's DDSP-SVC 6.3 graphs without weights (the DDSP synthesiser and one rectified-flow step). Imported DDSP-SVC singing voices run on them.

entries.title: PC-NSF-HiFiGAN 44.1 kHz
entries.description: openvpi's pitch-controllable NSF-HiFiGAN vocoder (44.1 kHz, hop 512, 128 mel bins, release 2025.02), exported with a continuous-phase input. The vocoder of DDSP-SVC 6.3 voices.
